# `external_metering`

Integrates with an external metering service for pre-request balance checks and post-response token usage reporting.

## Configuration Notes

Tenant identity is resolved from the highest-trust source available: verified `{prefix}*` metadata written by an authentication filter, then the `identity_header_guard` filter's namespaced `{namespace}.{prefix}*` metadata, then raw `{prefix}*` request headers. A higher tier always wins, so forged client headers can never override verified claims, and identity headers plus client credentials are always stripped before the request is forwarded. Both event types carry `data.organization_id` and `data.cost_center` from `{prefix}organization-id` and `{prefix}cost-center`. When absent, those fields are empty strings rather than invented defaults.

When no `{prefix}model` identity header names the model and `model_to_provider` mapped the request, balance checks and usage events use the client-facing model ID it recorded rather than the provider target. That filter buffers the request body, so its body pass completes before this filter's request hook runs the balance check.

Ordering: declare `external_metering` *before* `token_count` in the filter chain so response hooks (which run in reverse order) execute after token extraction, and after any verification filter (`identity_header_guard`, authentication) so captured identity metadata is already present. The model-policy preflight always runs before provider dispatch: after a rejection, zero provider requests have been made.

Response contract (stable bodies): an explicit budget denial rejects with 429 and body `token budget exhausted`; an explicit model denial rejects with 403 and body `model not allowed for this user`, regardless of either `fail_open` setting and with precedence over budget exhaustion; a verdict unavailable under a fail-closed gate rejects with 503 and body `metering system unavailable`. With model policy enabled, a missing trusted identity rejects with 403 and body `tenant identity required for model authorization`; an unresolvable model rejects with 403 and body `request model required for model authorization`; conflicting or ambiguous model sources reject with 403 and body `conflicting model inputs for model authorization`; and a request body larger than the pre-read bound rejects with 413 before dispatch.

Buffering: with model policy enabled the request body is pre-read once, bounded by the standard JSON body maximum (10 MiB); requests exceeding the bound reject with 413. The bound is enforced by the filter itself, so other filters in the pipeline that buffer more cannot raise it. Only the top-level `"model"` field is inspected — the body is never re-serialized or copied for the preflight. Once `model_to_provider` recorded a client-facing model, the buffered body has already been rewritten to the *provider* target, so it is no longer a model source: the preflight then compares the identity claim against the recorded client-facing model alone.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `metering_url` | string | yes | Base URL of the external metering service (required). |
| `allow_private_endpoint` | bool | no | Allow the metering endpoint to resolve to non-public addresses (loopback, private, link-local). Defaults to `false`, so callouts are rejected before connecting unless the operator opts in. Cloud metadata, unspecified, and multicast addresses remain blocked. |
| `timeout_seconds` | integer | no | HTTP timeout in seconds for all metering calls. |
| `feature_key` | string | no | Entitlement feature key used in balance check URL path. |
| `source` | string | no | `CloudEvents` `source` field value. |
| `provider` | string | no | Static provider name attributed to emitted `CloudEvents`. |
| `fail_open` | bool | no | When `true` (default), requests proceed if the metering service is unavailable. When `false`, requests are rejected with 503. This is the *billing* gate's availability policy. |
| `model_policy_check` | bool | no | When `true`, the entitlement preflight also enforces the metering service's model-policy verdict (`modelAllowed` in the response): an explicit denial rejects with 403 before any provider request, regardless of `fail_open`. Disabled by default for compatibility with services that return only `hasAccess`. When enabled, every metered request needs a trusted tenant identity and a resolvable public model; the request body is pre-read (bounded by the standard JSON body limit, 10 MiB; larger bodies reject with 413) so the verdict is decided before provider dispatch. Every available model source — the identity header, the `model_to_provider` client model, and (when no client model was recorded, since a recorded rewrite leaves the body naming the provider target) the request body — must agree: conflicting non-empty sources, or a body `"model"` member that is ambiguous (duplicate or escaped key spellings) or undecodable (escaped or non-string value), reject with 403 rather than authorizing a model the provider does not receive. When identity comes from raw `{prefix}*` request headers, the ingress boundary must strip client-supplied copies and set the headers from authenticated data: this filter cannot distinguish client-set headers. |
| `model_policy_fail_open` | bool | no | Availability policy for the model-policy gate when `model_policy_check` is enabled, independent of the billing `fail_open`: when the model verdict is unavailable (missing, `null`, wrongly typed, unusable payload, non-2xx, timeout, transport error), `true` admits the request and `false` (default) rejects with 503. An explicit `modelAllowed: false` rejection is never affected by this setting. |
| `identity_header_prefix` | string | no | Prefix for tenant identity headers to capture and strip. Expected headers: `{prefix}username`, `{prefix}group`, `{prefix}subscription`, `{prefix}model`, `{prefix}organization-id`, `{prefix}cost-center`. |
| `identity_metadata_namespace` | string | no | Metadata namespace the `identity_header_guard` filter writes captured identity headers under. Must match that filter's `metadata_namespace` setting when both run in one pipeline. |
| `default_username` | string | no | Fallback username when no identity header is present. If set, requests without `{prefix}username` are still metered under this name. If unset, metering is skipped entirely. |
| `default_model` | string | no | Fallback model name when no identity model header is present. |
| `internal_auth_token` | CredentialSource | no | Optional internal bearer token for authenticating metering callouts (the balance check and the usage report). One of `value \| env_var \| file`, read through the shared [`CredentialSource`] core: bounded reads, restart-free file rotation (ideal for a Kubernetes projected Secret), and fail-closed publication. When omitted, callouts are sent unauthenticated (unchanged behavior). |

## Example

```yaml
filter: external_metering
metering_url: "http://metering-service:8080"
timeout_seconds: 5
feature_key: "inference-tokens"
source: "ai-gateway"
provider: "openai"
fail_open: true
identity_header_prefix: "x-tenant-"
identity_metadata_namespace: "identity"
default_username: "anonymous"
default_model: "unknown"
model_policy_check: true
model_policy_fail_open: false
```
